title: Aye mere laal Baqir
body:
Aye mere laal Baqir (as) x2times
Haay aye mere laal Baqir (as) x2times
Sajjad (as) roke bole aye mere laal Baqir (as)
Kar sabr mere beta x2times khudh ko sambhal Baqir (as)
1)math peet Sina o sar math Kar tu aise nouha.
Tar khoon me ho lekin zindaa Abhi hoon beta.
Khaake safar ko sar par x2times
aise na daal Baqir (as).
<<DIVIDER>>
2) touq o giraa se Teri gardan bandhi hui hai.
Yeh wazn hai ke jisse qam pushth ho gayi hai.
Zaalim se rahem ka tu x2times
math kar sawaal baqir (as).
<<DIVIDER>>
3) deen ki baqa ki khatir tune tamache khaaye.
Tu wo imam jisne tifli me gham uthaaye.
Duniya na la sakengi x2times
Teri misaal Baqir (as).
<<DIVIDER>>
4)har gaam imtehan hai aur shaam ka safar hai.
Beparda bibiyaa hai aur shaam ka safar hai.
Mujhko rula raha hai x2times
bas ye khayaal Baqir (as).
<<DIVIDER>>
5) saydaaniyoo ko zaalim durre laga raha hai.
Unka khayaal mujhko har dam rula raha hai.
Gar ho sake to unki x2times
mushkil ko taal baqir (as).
<<DIVIDER>>
6)zadd par hai ranj o gham ke meri bahen Sakina (as)
Ruqsaar par tamache sehti hai woh hazeena.
Jaakar meri bahen ko x2times
gham se nikaal Kar Baqir (as).
<<DIVIDER>>
7) karboobala ke Ban me gham tune jo sahe hai.
Sadme jo tere dil par bazaar me lage hai.
Hoga in ghamoo ka x2times ab indemaal baqir (as).
<<DIVIDER>>
8)aye noor zakhm apne ashkoo se dhooke abid (as).
Aye noor keh rahe the baqir (as) se roote abid (as).
Sahe le safar ke saare x2times
ranjoo malaal Baqir (as)
Aye mere laal mere
Sajjad (as) rooke bole aye mere laal Baqir (as).
Kar shukr mere beta x2times
Khudh ko sambhaal Baqir (as)
